name: codex-autoresume-guard
description: Guard conversations against usage-limit stalls: auto-continue threads and goals when the 5h (and optionally weekly) quota window resets, with per-resume model/reasoning settings.

interface.longDescription: Keep long tasks and goals running unattended. When the ChatGPT usage limit interrupts a conversation, AutoResume Guard waits for the quota window to reset and continues it - goals via the official continue action, ordinary threads via a resume prompt - with your chosen model and reasoning effort per resume.
defaultPrompt: 为当前对话开启自动继续守护
Enable auto-continue guarding for this conversation with model gpt-6.1-sol and high reasoning
Show my quota windows and guard status
